## Ingredients

- Cooked spaghetti squash 
- Balsamic vinegar
- Feta cheese 
- Oil
- Toasted pumpkin seeds
- salt

More on the spaghetti squash, follow the instructions here:  <https://www.loveandlemons.com/how-to-cook-spaghetti-squash/>

## Instructions

Cook the Spaghetti squash for ~40 min at 400F (you don't want it to be overcooked and mushy) with salt and oil and pepper 

Combine with ingredients above to make a salad
